;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April–August 2019)]]
**The [[Syrian Army]] and the [[Turkish Land Forces]] exchange heavy fire in the northern [[Idlib Governorate]], in what Turkish officials described as a deliberate mortar attack on one of their observation posts in [[Murak, Syria|Murak]] that wounded three Turkish troops. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/syrian-government-attacks-turkish-post-idlib-190616181759469.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2019/06/16/assad-regime-forces-attack-turkish-observation-point-in-idlib (''Daily Sabah'')]
**At least 12 people are killed after [[Jihadism|jihadists]] shelled a village in [[Aleppo Governorate]] with [[Mortar (weapon)|mortars]]. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ani/12-killed-in-aleppo-following-mortar-shelling-119061700064_1.html (''Business standard'')]
*In the past week, over 160 people have been killed and 40 villages destroyed in attacks between tribes in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/scores-dead-revenge-attacks-dr-congo-190616174901617.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 South American blackout]]
**A massive [[Power outage|blackout]] hits [[Argentina]], [[Uruguay]], and southern [[Brazil]], leaving millions without power. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/16/world/americas/power-failure-argentina-uruguay.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Law and crime
*A group of bandits attack a village in the Shinkafi local government area of [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]], killing at least 34 civilians. The gunmen arrived on motorcycles and opened fire on civilians indiscriminately, later burning down homes. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-northwest/armed-gang-kills-at-least-34-in-northwest-nigeria-police-say-idUSKCN1TH0F8 (Reuters)]
;International relations
*[[Israel–United States relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] formally unveils [[Trump Heights]], a new settlement in the [[Golan Heights]], named after [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] for his decision to recognise Israeli sovereignty over the [[Status of the Golan Heights|occupied]] territory. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48656431 (BBC News)]
*[[Japan–Mongolia relations]], [[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[Foreign Minister of Japan]] [[Tarō Kōno]] seeks cooperation from Mongolia over efforts to settle the issue of past abductions of Japanese nationals by North Korea, as Mongolia maintains friendly ties with Pyongyang. Japan has no ties with North Korea and pushes for further sanctions. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/16/national/politics-diplomacy/japan-seeks-cooperation-mongolia-north-korean-abduction-issue-denuclearization/#.XQbFV7xKjcc (''The Japan Times'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**Citizens of [[Guatemala]] head to the polls to vote for their next [[President of Guatemala|president]] and new members of the country's [[Congress of the Republic of Guatemala|congress]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48621524 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Conservative Party leadership election]]
**The first televised debate between [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] candidates for [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|Leader of the Conservative Party]] and [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom]] takes place in [[London]]. Frontrunnner [[Boris Johnson]] refuses to attend. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-48654729 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]
**The scheduled peaceful mass protest, despite bill suspension yesterday,  of nearly  2 million people  gather in Victoria Square demanding the legislation be withdrawn. If the organizers numbers are confirmed, this is the largest protest  ever. [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Hong Kong leader]] [[Carrie Lam]]  apologizes for proposing the bill. Police say turnout was 338,000 at its peak. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-48656471 (BBC News)]

;Sports
* [[Toyota Motorsport GmbH|Toyota Gazoo Racing]] wins the [[2019 24 Hours of Le Mans]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/jun/16/le-mans-24-hours-fernando-alonso-toyota (''The Guardian'')]

** [[Gary Woodland]] wins his first [[Men's major golf championships|major championship]], finishing three shots ahead of two-time defending champion [[Brooks Koepka]] at [[Pebble Beach Golf Links|Pebble Beach, California]].
